usedFor: Cuttly shortens links, and “Short URL” creates a new short link from a long one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Short URL” in Cuttly
bestTemplate.why: A channel message can start a short link, so shared links stay tidy.

watchOut: Check the long link that reaches “Short URL”, since it makes a new short link from whatever it receives.
